name: Hero: Expunge makes Mongoose Bite apply Cobra Venom (#12493)
contract: Expunge 283244: 'Your Chimera Shot or Mongoose Bite now applies Cobra Venom' (283245). Its DBC proc data matched neither spell: ProcFlags 0x100 accept ranged-class spells only, which excludes the melee Mongoose Bite, and the class mask family 9 flag 1 0x1 is the Steady Shot family flag, not Chimera Shot (flag 2 0x1) or Mongoose Bite (flag 2 0x2000000).
The new spell_proc row accepts melee and ranged class hits with family 9 flag 2 0x2000001 at the DBC ProcChance 100, so the result is deterministic.
A level 60 Hero bites a dummy once without Expunge (CONTROL: no Cobra Venom), waits out the 5 s category cooldown, learns Expunge and bites again: the dummy must then carry Cobra Venom.

steps.label: CONTROL: without Expunge the bite applies no Cobra Venom
Past Mongoose Bite's 5 s category cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: Mongoose Bite applies Cobra Venom
